text:
sam: Quick brief request — need a field-ready one-pager + single summary slide aimed at CISO/procurement and infra/platform leads. Core asks: security posture, SLA callouts, and a simple decision guide for choosing hosted/dedicated/private. Publish next Tue.

alana: Love the brief. Keep it decision-first: four bullets (who, what, why, next step). Short headline options: "Inference with Guardrails" or "SLA-Ready Inference: Hosted to On-Prem". Prefer the latter for clarity.

trina: Sales asks for three CTAs: "Request compliance brief", "Get an SLA estimate", "Start a private trial". Also include a one-line placeholder customer quote: "Kept our features online during peak load."

lee: Bench numbers for credibility — proposing a tiny table row: Hosted (p95 chat gen) ~290ms, Dedicated (reserved) p95 ~100ms, Private (on-prem) p95 ~150ms. Add a short sentence: "Caching + batching often drop effective cost by ~30% on conversational workloads."

alana: Good. Also call out routing policy in one-liner: latency-first -> Dedicated, cost-first -> Hosted, compliance -> Private. Add a micro-diagram on the slide (design).

design-bot: I'll create a 1-slide PNG: left column decision flow, right column SLA badges (uptime, p95). Need final copy by Mon noon. Will do two visual variants: conservative and product-forward.

ops-bot: Inbound routing notes: capture form fields: primary concern (security/latency/cost), estimated monthly tokens, region, enterprise checkbox. Rules: if primary concern == security -> route to AE + security SME; if enterprise checkbox + >50M tokens/yr -> escalate to AE immediately. Template: https://internal/redwood/playbooks/inbound-sla (placeholder).

sam: Messaging tone: short, procurement-friendly. Don't deep-dive into kernel/quantization details on the one-pager; link to appendix. But include 1-sentence tech caveat: "Same model weights across modes; aggressive quantization may slightly change outputs."

trina: Webinar hook: "SLA-first Inference: How Enterprises Keep LLMs Predictable" — 30m total: 10m talk, 10m demo (routing/failover), 10m Q&A. Co-host with SE + customer if possible. Landing page should ask deploy mode interest.

lee: For the micro-benchmark section, include two reproducible mini-prompts (short convo and long context) and expected p95 ranges so customers can validate. Also attach a PNG with the benchmark chart.

alana: Legal/regulatory note: word SLA targets as "target P95" for private deployments on customer infra. For Dedicated + Hosted we can reference contractual SLA terms.

sam: Asset owner list: 1) One-pager copy (trina) 2) Slide + micro-diagram (design-bot) 3) Benchmark PNG + prompts (lee) 4) Landing + routing form (ops) 5) Sales email templates + FAQ (trina). Preview with Sales Fri AM; final Mon EOD.

trina: I'll draft the one-pager now — headline: "SLA-Ready Inference: Hosted to On-Prem". First paragraph: 2-sentence problem + 3 bullets benefits (predictability, security controls, cost levers).

lee: I'll upload bench PNG by Mon and include the actual numbers and prompt seeds.

design-bot: Acknowledged. Sending initial mockups by EOD.

ops-bot: Recommended inbound tags: ["security", "sla", "private-trial", "dedicated", "hosted", "webinar"]. Regex rule: /SOC2|PCI|HIPAA/i -> route high priority.

sam: Thanks all. Quick sync Mon 9am to finalize. If you can't make it, drop comments in the doc. :calendar: :rocket:
